21 Indian Seafarers Safe After Kuwaiti Tanker Hit in Strait of Hormuz

A Kuwait-flagged oil tanker carrying 21 Indian sailors was struck by a projectile in the Strait of Hormuz. All 21 Indian seafarers on board were reported to be safe following the incident.
